description: Owner only, ask the human first: show or hide a small "Powered by ohmyho.st" flag on the right edge of the production site. While it is on, this project's custom domain uses no domain credits on any plan and also works on a Free workspace, and each Paid period bought through Stripe adds 250 credits to the workspace, however many of its projects show the flag. Hiding it is refused while a Free workspace's domain depends on it. Replay the same key and value after uncertainty to get the first answer without switching again; every new switch needs a new key.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: powered_by_flag_set
